reviewer: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1), high effort, independent of author and orchestrator
sanitization: Counts and timestamps only. No account hashes, request identifiers, Ray IDs, IP data, credentials, or content.
tools: Cloudflare API MCP: workers/observability/telemetry/query (dataset cloudflare-workers, dry=true)
Cloudflare API MCP: workers script settings, schedules, KV key listing (counts only), R2 object listing, AI Gateway log metadata
Wrangler 4.124.0 --profile sdf: d1 execute --remote on stellar-raven-usage

toolResponses.definition: Logged top-level MCP search (source=tool) and execute events, including error responses; joined to the mcp_request summary through the platform invocation id.
toolResponses.method: One-hour windows, events view, limit 2000, ABR level 1 in every window, no window reached the limit, event ids deduplicated.
toolResponses.note: Retention is rolling; the first hours of the prior window had partly expired by review time, so the two windows are not identical.

sixHourAggregates.method: Calculations view grouped by evt, 28 windows of six hours, ABR level 1; some windows reported sample intervals above 1, so these are estimates.

d1.idFormat: all 13 ids use the application request UUID; none fell back to the Ray id

archivePeriod.boundary: No archive row exists before 14:34:59.886 UTC and the extra log window ends at 14:34:59.000 UTC, so no response is double counted.

workerRequests.metric: GraphQL workersInvocationsAdaptive sum.requests by status; all Worker invocations, not tool responses or people.
workerRequests.retentionLimit: The account cannot query data older than 12w6d; July metrics stop being queryable around 2026-09-30.

invocationOutcomes.method: cf-worker-event grouped by $workers.outcome per six-hour window
invocationOutcomes.canceledShareRange: about 10 to 15 percent of producer invocations per window

supportingActivity.label: Separately labeled. Never a substitute for tool responses or active tool users.

oauthGrants.meaning: Lower bound on accounts that completed OAuth authorization since launch and still hold a grant, measured 2026-09-11T15:35Z.

oauthRequestAccountsPerDayChunk.meaning: Distinct accounts with any successful OAuth MCP request, protocol traffic included; most never call a tool in a given day.

aiGatewayDemoLogs.caveat: Mixes local evaluation runs (user agent node in 43 of the 50 oldest rows) with playground traffic; not user activity.

sourcesCheckedAndEmpty.logpushJobs: Listing returned an authentication error for this token; unverified.
sourcesCheckedAndEmpty.otherDatastores: No other D1, KV, or Analytics Engine dataset holds Raven usage.

conclusion: July and August tool responses and active users are unrecoverable. The prior audit's September figures hold within a few responses and the 61 account lower bound is reproduced exactly.
